name: devai-fix
description: Repair one failing engineering concern with explicit file bounds and focused verification.

lint.description: Repair lint failures in explicitly selected package files.

typecheck.description: Repair type errors in explicitly selected package source files.

build.description: Repair a build failure in explicitly selected package source or configuration files.

test.description: Repair a failing test or its implementation within explicitly selected files.

coverage.description: Add focused tests for an observed coverage gap without changing production behavior.
